我们正在为[Root.GetName]上未来的扩张做土地整备时，一座巨大的结构仿佛在一瞬间凭空出现

texts.en:
As we were preparing land for future expansion on [Root.GetName], a large structure seemingly blinked into existence.

The structure is emitting highly unstable energy waves causing it to intermittently appear and disappear from view. This explains why it was not present in initial scans of this sector.

When visible, unintelligible symbols adorn its sealed exterior, but match no known language in our records. 

No apparent function can be discerned. The construct has thus far caused no harm but it is obstructing our development efforts.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
我们对[Root.GetName]上这座闪烁的建筑进行分析后，确信该物体会以某种方式扭曲光线。

在下方的硅酸盐地幔中发现了异常的地热活动。这种强大的能源为这座茕茕孑立的建筑提供动力，但其能量水平有很大的波动。

即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。

其密封外墙是由某种不明高反应性物质构成。尝试强制进入建筑只会导致其电磁场进一步失稳。我们可以尝试强制切开通道以进入研究，但不可预测的失稳风险非常巨大。
texts.en:
Analysis of the shimmering building on [Root.GetName] leads us to assume the object is bending or distorting light somehow.

Exceptional geothermal activity has been detected in the silicate mantle below. This potent energy source powers the isolated structure, but its levels are fluctuating wildly.

While our understanding of the building's properties has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.

Its sealed exterior is comprised of unfamiliar and highly-reactive materials. Initial attempts to force entry into the structure only destabilized the building's electromagnetic fields further. We could cut our way in to learn more, but there is considerable risk of unpredictable destabilization.

texts.zh:

即便我对该建筑性质的理解正在逐渐加深，但仍未能进入其中——假设确实的能进去的话。

texts.en:
Analysis of the shimmering building on [Root.GetName] leads us to assume the object is somehow producing an intermittent cloaking effect.

Exceptional geothermal activity has been detected in the silicate mantle below. This potent energy source powers the isolated structure, but its levels are fluctuating wildly.

While our understanding of the building's cloaking effects has grown, we have thus far been unable to enter it - if this is in fact even possible.

Its sealed exterior is comprised of unfamiliar and highly-reactive materials. Initial attempts to force entry into the structure only destabilized the building's electromagnetic fields further. We could cut our way in to learn more, but there is considerable risk of unpredictable destabilization.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
尝试以暴力方式进入[Root.GetName]上的建筑招致了一场灾难。我们的设备进一步让建筑的能量模式失稳，引发了一系列剧烈的爆炸。如今它只剩下一堆灰烬。

其意外的毁灭进一步招致出人意料的结果。附近的山谷里出现了一座被遗弃已久的外星人定居点废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损。

这种不寻常的技术的确切工作原理对我们来说仍然是未解之谜，但我们从这次经历中得到了些许新知识。我们将重新利用这种强大的地热能源为自己的殖民地服务。
texts.en:
Attempts to force entry into the structure on [Root.GetName] ended in disaster. Our equipment further destabilized the building's energy patterns, causing a series of potent explosions. It is now little more than an ashen wreck.

Its accidental destruction produced an unexpected outcome. The razed ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

It seems the object was somehow projecting a powerful cloaking field on the former colony; what they were hiding from remains a mystery, but what is certain is that they perished regardless of their efforts. Nothing of archaeological value remains intact.

The exact workings of this unusual technology remain unknown to us, but we gleaned some new knowledge from the experience. We will repurpose this potent geothermal energy source for our own colony.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.

texts.zh:
对[Root.GetName]上外形建筑外部的怪异文字进行的研究表明它其实是某种交互界面。我们利用它打开了一扇通向其空荡荡内部的隐藏门，一间宽敞的控制室出现在眼前。

尽管不了解其深层的工作原理，但我们通过试错法对它的命令有了基本的了解。中断它的功能时出现了一个意想不到的结果；在附近的山谷里出现了一处被遗弃已久的外星人定居点的废墟。

似乎这个物体以某种方式在前殖民地投射了一个强大的隐形场；至于是为了躲避什么仍然是个谜，但可以肯定，不管他们做过何种努力，如今都已是死寂一片。没有一件有考古价值的东西完好无损，但至少我们的科学家已经彻底掌握了这个控制室。

现在我们可以将这座建筑奇怪的隐形场稳定化并且扩展到整座山谷了。这可以大幅提升我们殖民地的安全系数。
texts.en:
Further study of the strange markings on the exterior of the alien structure on [Root.GetName] revealed them to be an interface of sorts. We were able to manipulate them to open a hidden door into the building's deserted interior, revealing a vast control chamber.

Although ignorant of its deeper workings, we gained basic understanding over the commands using trial and error. Interrupting its functions produced an unexpected outcome; the derelict ruins of a long-abandoned alien settlement appeared in a nearby valley.

It seems the object was somehow projecting a powerful cloaking field on the former colony; what they were hiding from remains a mystery, but what is certain is they perished regardless of their efforts. While nothing of archaeological value remains intact, our scientists have made excellent use of the control chamber.

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's strange cloaking effect to cover the entire valley. It will be a great enhancement to our colony's safety.

We are now able to stabilize and expand the building's cloaking field to protect the entire valley, and have greatly increased our knowledge of cloaking technologies.

summary.text:
# 凭空出现 / Out of Nowhere

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC: BioGenesis

## 如何开始 How it starts

殖民地满3年时随机事件池以20/739抽中 strange_worlds.30（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3839）。触发前提：BioGenesis DLC，人类玩家的非首都、非母星、仍由原建立者持有的人造以外殖民星球，没有地面战斗，也未被占领；并且该殖民地尚未触发过其他“奇异世界”事件（colony_event 旗标），每个国家每条故事只触发一次。

A colony turning 3 years old can draw strange_worlds.30 (20/739, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3839). Preconditions: BioGenesis DLC, a human player's non-capital, non-homeworld, original-owner, non-artificial colony without ground combat or occupation, which has not yet had another Strange Worlds event (colony_event flag); once per country per chain.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

strange_worlds.30“凭空出现”：调查，给星球加“闪烁结构”障碍。180±180天后 strange_worlds.35“视觉异常”（正文随是否有常规隐形科技而变，物理研究）：a“暴力闯入”——180±180天后 strange_worlds.40“失控反应”（隐形科技进度10%，地热热点）；b“继续外部研究”——360±180天后 strange_worlds.45“指令舱室”（隐形科技进度20%，古代隐形阵列矿点）。

strange_worlds.30 "Out of Nowhere": investigate; the planet gets a shimmering-structure blocker. 180+-180 days later strange_worlds.35 "Visual Anomalies" (text varies with regular cloaking tech; physics research): a "Use brute force" - 180+-180 days later strange_worlds.40 "Runaway Reaction" (10% cloaking tech progress, geothermal hotspot); b "Continue external studies" - 360+-180 days later strange_worlds.45 "Command Chamber" (20% cloaking progress, ancient cloaking array deposit).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

a（40）与 b（45）互斥。

a (40) and b (45) are exclusive.
